serves_registry_rows: grid.carbon_intensity (the twin's Power map: gCO2 per person-year added or saved, by place)
provenance: conformance/scene/SCOUT_GRID.md (documentation only: published pages and PDFs; no dataset was downloaded; each row says how it was read); version 3 adds 700 rows read from one dataset under GRID-1 (conformance/scene/GRID1_PREREG.md, GRID1_RESULTS.md)

verdict.reason: priors gathered from documents; nothing scored. Web pages were read through a fetch tool's extraction, not raw; 52 US state rows were transcribed by eye and are rated B for it

law: each row is a price in a regime: its year and its kind are part of the value. Kinds kept apart: generation or consumption mix; direct or life-cycle; CO2 or all gases; per kWh generated or delivered; location-based or market-based; average or marginal; and the edition of the method. Rows of different kinds must not be compared or mapped together without saying so.
warning: an average rate times a change in load is an attribution, and must not be called emissions avoided. For a long-run 'this load never existed' reading use the average, location-based row of a stated year; for a short-run change use a non-baseload or operating-margin row where one exists (United States, India). The marginal map is flatter and higher than the average one: US subregions span 6.4 times on average rates and 2.1 times on non-baseload rates.
shares_by_source: as published; several are partial and do not sum to 100
disagreements: rows that disagree for one place and year are both kept and never averaged (Ember against IEA for 2025; Ember's own editions for the United States 2023: 369 and 393)
moves: world about -1.5 % a year (2015 to 2025); United States average -4.1 % a year and non-baseload -0.8 % a year (2018 to 2023); not always down (South Africa +5.5 % in 2024)
licences: rows read from documents are facts quoted with their sources, each with its licence as read. The 700 rows with read = dataset are an extract of Ember's database under CC BY 4.0 and are covered by the attribution block, not by 'facts quoted'
holds_no_real_feature: no person, household or building; places are countries, grid subregions, states and provinces
datasets_not_fetched_needing_approval: listed in SCOUT_GRID.md; the first (Ember Yearly Electricity Data, CC BY 4.0) would replace most trust-C country rows, the third (EPA eGRID2023 workbooks, public domain) would check the transcribed state rows
changes: version 2 (2026-11-12): wording only, no value changed. 42 fields carried a drafting mark ('[my reading ...]') that a consumer publishing the text verbatim would show; they now read '(the scout's reading ...)' or '(as summarised; the licence page was not read at source)'. Reported by the twin. Version 3 (2026-11-12): 700 rows added from Ember's yearly electricity data under GRID-1; four kinds of field added to version-2 rows by a frozen rule; no version-2 value changed.

added_fields.superseded_by: on a version-2 row rated C whose kind says it is Ember's figure: the same place and year, read at source
added_fields.map_alternative: on any other version-2 row rated C of a place that has a new row: a different kind or year; the named row is the one to draw on a one-kind map
added_fields.same_series_as / disagrees_with: on an Ember row read on a page, where the file gives the same place and year; the difference is stated when over 0.5 g
added_fields.none_of_these: says the old value was wrong; no value, kind or trust of a version-2 row changed, and no row rated A carries any
added_fields.year_lag: file_latest_year (2024, the latest year with an intensity for at least half the file's countries) less the row's year, on a place's latest row: -1 means the place has 2025 (94 countries and territories), 0 means 2024 is its latest (99), positive means older (16). A one-year map must filter on year, not on 'latest'
added_fields.provisional: empty on every row: the file has no column marking an estimated year, so a 2025 value may be an estimate and this table cannot say
added_fields.small_system: generation under 1 TWh in that year (50 countries and territories)

grid1_readings.R1: met: 20 of 21 rows read on Ember's pages are within 2 % or 1 g of the file; Latin America differs by 2.0 % (247 on the page, 252.1 in the file under the name 'Latin America and Caribbean')
grid1_readings.S1a: met: 5 of 5 secondhand rows 'said to be Ember' for 2025 are within 5 % of the file (Indonesia the farthest, 680 against 705.3)
grid1_readings.S2: KILLED: the file's life-cycle figure is lower than the official direct figure in 2 of 5 places in doubt (South Africa 2024: 717 against 994; Germany 2025: 334 against 344, a near kind). Life-cycle is not the higher figure across sources; a legend must not say so
grid1_readings.S3: 209 countries and territories and 15 groupings have a row; p90 over p10 among the 99 whose latest year is 2024 is 5.8; all 12 countries that had only rows rated C now have a row rated B
